description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003 Order under Section 20 (5)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Consumer Affairs Authority exercising its powers under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act to rescind several previous orders. It deals with regulatory matters, specifically the modification of existing regulations through the rescission of previous orders. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it concerns statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
